jobs.title: Head of R&D
jobs.description:
About Our Client
Our client is an international industrial group with a strong heritage in engineering excellence, innovation and sustainability. Operating globally, the organisation designs and manufactures high quality electromechanical solutions for the building and infrastructure environment.
The company is characterized by a long-term vision and an entrepreneurial culture. Innovation, product reliability and responsible lifecycle management are central to its strategy. To further strengthen its technology leadership, the group is seeking an experienced executive to lead its global Research & Development organisation.

Job Description
The Head of R&D will lead and coordinate all R&D efforts of the group and is pivotal for driving innovation and advancing technological capabilities. As member of the division management and a direct reporting line to the CEO, this person will manage:
• Strategic and operational management of the R&D center with complete responsibility for budget and results
• A multidisciplinary R&D team of mechanical, electrical, hardware and software teams
• Analyzing new, innovative technologies and assessing their applicability in the industry
• Definition of the development roadmap in close collaboration with Product Management
• Steering of all development projects worldwide from the idea up to the market readiness under consideration of the critical time to market and budget targets
• Securing the technological know-how within the group through detailed documentation and appropriate training and education measures
• Close collaboration with internal as well as external stakeholders
• Responsibility for patents and certifications
• Continuous improvement of the R&D processes

The Successful Applicant
• Master's degree in electrical or electro-mechanical engineering, PhD is a very nice to have.
• At least 10 years of experience in a similar (international) function
• Proven leadership capacity managing multidisciplinary teams (60+ fte)
• Driven by passion to further develop technological and quality leadership
• Strong track record in developing complex mechatronic or electromechanical products
• Energetic, charismatic personality driven by scientific curiosity and fighting spirit to get ideas done
• As innovator you can think out of the box with a structured and target focused working style
• Entrepreneurial mind-set and strength in conceptional and analytical thinking
• Flexibility for international commuting
• Fluent in English, German is a nice to have

What's on Offer
A senior leadership role with significant autonomy and influence within a high-performing, international business. Competitive executive package offered.

titleByLocale.en: Chief Commercial Officer, Europe - UHNW Client Acquisition
titleByLocale.fr: Chief Commercial Officer, Europe - UHNW Client Acquisition
titleByLocale.it: Chief Commercial Officer, Europe - UHNW Client Acquisition
titleByLocale.de: Chief Commercial Officer, Europe - UHNW Client Acquisition

jobs.description:
About Our Client
Our client is a highly discreet Swiss organisation operating at the crossroads of ultra-luxury hospitality and premium medical services. The group caters to an international clientele of ultra-high net worth individuals seeking exclusive, science-led health and longevity programmes delivered in exceptional environments.
To support its next phase of growth, the company is looking to appoint a Sr commercial leader with a true hunter mindset, capable of unlocking new UHNW client channels across Europe and beyond.
This is a front-line revenue role, combining strategic influence with direct client origination at the highest level.

Job Description
UHNW Client Acquisition & Revenue Growth (Core Focus)
• Drive direct business development and revenue generation, with a strong focus on new client acquisition among UHNW and "traditional money" networks.
• Personally originate and convert opportunities through trusted relationships with family offices, private banks, wealth managers, luxury intermediaries, and influential gatekeepers.
• Build a robust personal pipeline, acting as a true ambassador and rainmaker for the brand.
• Identify and unlock non-traditional channels to access discreet, high-value clientele.
Strategic Partnerships & Network Expansion
• Develop deep, long-term partnerships within the European UHNW ecosystem.
• Leverage existing networks to accelerate access to established wealth circles and legacy client bases.
• Position the organisation within highly selective ecosystems through credibility, discretion, and peer-level engagement.
European Market Leadership
• Define and execute a targeted European growth strategy, prioritising high-value markets and client segments.
• Optimise commercial performance in mature markets through client insight, pricing sophistication, and tailored approaches.
• Ensure a consistent, ultra-premium client experience aligned with the brand's positioning.
Global Alignment & Influence
• Collaborate with global leadership to align on key accounts, targets, and commercial priorities.
• Contribute to the evolution of best practices in UHNW client acquisition and relationship management.
• Act as a bridge between headquarters and international commercial teams, with a strong external market perspective.
Leadership & Representation
• Lead and inspire a small team of Sr sales profiles, while remaining personally hands-on in revenue generation.
• Represent the organisation in highly exclusive environments, maintaining the highest standards of discretion and credibility.
• Act as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on market trends, opportunities, and client expectations.

The Successful Applicant
• 15+ years of experience in high-end business development / sales, with a clear track record as a hunter and deal originator.
• Proven ability to access and convert UHNW and "traditional money" clientele, ideally across Europe and international markets.
• Strong, active network within family offices, private banking, luxury ecosystem, or similar ultra-premium industries.
• Experience in environments where trust, discretion, and relationship depth are critical to success.
• Combination of regional exposure and HQ / strategic visibility.
• Demonstrated ability to open doors at the highest level, not only manage existing relationships.
• Entrepreneurial mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and commercial drive.
• Based in Switzerland or willing to relocate.
• Fluent English and French; additional languages are a plus.
• High flexibility for international travel and client-facing engagements.

What's on Offer
• Prestigious name with lots of potential to expand

jobs.title: Directeur(ice) Comptabilité, Reporting & Consolidation
jobs.description:
About Our Client
Notre client est un acteur dans le secteur des services financiers, reconnu pour la qualité de son positionnement sur des marchés reconnus. Il intervient sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur, au service d'une clientèle fidèle.
Dans un contexte de transformation soutenue, notre client poursuit une stratégie ambitieuse alliant croissance, innovation et renforcement de ses fonctions de pilotage. L'environnement de travail se distingue par un haut niveau d'exigence, une forte exposition aux enjeux réglementaires et une volonté constante d'amélioration des processus et des outils.
Rejoindre cette organisation, c'est intégrer une structure solide et en évolution, offrant des perspectives de développement au sein d'une fonction finance au cœur des enjeux stratégiques du Groupe.

Job Description
Rattaché à la direction financière, vous intervenez au cœur des activités du Groupe avec une responsabilité sur un périmètre comptable étendu. Vous encadrez une équipe dédiée et assurez la qualité, la cohérence et la transparence de l'ensemble des informations financières produites.Ce poste offre une exposition large aux différentes activités et constitue une opportunité naturelle de transition pour un profil expérimenté issu de l'audit externe (niveau Senior Manager minimum), souhaitant évoluer vers un rôle opérationnel avec une dimension managériale et stratégique.Vous contribuez activement à la production et à la fiabilité de l'information financière du Groupe, en assurant notamment :
• La coordination des travaux de clôture périodique et la sécurisation des livrables financiers dans des délais contraints
• La préparation et la revue des comptes ainsi que des états consolidés
• Le suivi des référentiels comptables applicables à l'activité et leur bonne mise en œuvre au sein des entités
Vous supervisez également les processus permettant de garantir une lecture consolidée de la performance :
• Organisation des cycles de consolidation et validation des données remontées
• Production d'analyses destinées aux instances de direction et aux organismes de supervision
• Contribution à la qualité et à la pertinence du reporting financier
Dans un environnement fortement régulé, vous participez à la maîtrise des risques financiers :
• Interaction régulière avec les fonctions de contrôle et les parties prenantes externes
• Suivi des obligations réglementaires applicables
• Encadrement des sujets fiscaux en lien avec des experts spécialisés
Vous jouez enfin un rôle actif dans l'évolution de la fonction finance :
• Optimisation des processus et renforcement des dispositifs de contrôle
• Participation à des projets d'amélioration des outils et des systèmes
• Contribution aux initiatives de transformation et d'automatisation
En tant que manager, vous accompagnez vos collaborateurs dans leur développement :
• Organisation et pilotage de l'activité de l'équipe
• Développement des compétences et montée en expertise
• Mise en place d'un environnement de travail structuré et collaboratif

The Successful Applicant
Vous justifiez d'une expérience significative en finance, acquise au sein d'un cabinet d'audit de premier plan, d'une structure de services financiers ou d'un environnement comparable.
Une expérience en audit externe à un niveau avancé constitue un atout particulièrement pertinent pour ce poste, notamment dans une logique de transition vers des responsabilités opérationnelles.
Vous disposez par ailleurs :
• D'une solide compréhension des problématiques de production financière et de consolidation
• D'une bonne maîtrise des environnements multi-entités et multi-devises
• D'une capacité à appréhender des activités financières diversifiées et leurs impacts comptables
• D'une aisance avec les systèmes d'information financiers et les outils de reporting
• Capacité à encadrer et structurer une équipe
• Exigence élevée en matière de qualité et de fiabilité
• Esprit d'analyse et sens critique développé
• Capacité à prendre du recul et à prioriser dans un environnement complexe
• Goût pour l'amélioration continue et les environnements en transformation
• Aptitude à interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés

What's on Offer
Opportunité de rejoindre une structure reconnue pour son excellence.

Vous encadrez une équipe dédiée et assurez la qualité, la cohérence et la transparence de l'ensemble des informations financières produites.Ce poste offre une exposition large aux différentes activités et constitue une opportunité naturelle de transition pour un profil expérimenté issu de l'audit externe (niveau Senior Manager minimum), souhaitant évoluer vers un rôle opérationnel avec une dimension managériale et stratégique.Vous contribuez activement à la production et à la fiabilité de l'information financière du Groupe, en assurant notamment :
• La coordination des travaux de clôture périodique et la sécurisation des livrables financiers dans des délais contraints
• La préparation et la revue des comptes ainsi que des états consolidés
• Le suivi des référentiels comptables applicables à l'activité et leur bonne mise en œuvre au sein des entités
Vous supervisez également les processus permettant de garantir une lecture consolidée de la performance :
• Organisation des cycles de consolidation et validation des données remontées
• Production d'analyses destinées aux instances de direction et aux organismes de supervision
• Contribution à la qualité et à la pertinence du reporting financier

• Interaction régulière avec les fonctions de contrôle et les parties prenantes externes
• Suivi des obligations réglementaires applicables
• Encadrement des sujets fiscaux en lien avec des experts spécialisés
Vous jouez enfin un rôle actif dans l'évolution de la fonction finance :
• Optimisation des processus et renforcement des dispositifs de contrôle
• Participation à des projets d'amélioration des outils et des systèmes
• Contribution aux initiatives de transformation et d'automatisation
En tant que manager, vous accompagnez vos collaborateurs dans leur développement :
• Organisation et pilotage de l'activité de l'équipe
• Développement des compétences et montée en expertise
• Mise en place d'un environnement de travail structuré et collaboratif

Vous justifiez d'une expérience significative en finance, acquise au sein d'un cabinet d'audit de premier plan, d'une structure de services financiers ou d'un environnement comparable.

• D'une solide compréhension des problématiques de production financière et de consolidation
• D'une bonne maîtrise des environnements multi-entités et multi-devises
• D'une capacité à appréhender des activités financières diversifiées et leurs impacts comptables

jobs.title: Director Legal & Compliance
jobs.description:
About Our Client
Our client is a niche asset manager with a strong track record located in Zurich. Due to their expansion plans they are looking for a pragmatic, hands-on Legal & Compliance Director to oversee its Legal & Compliance department.

Job Description
• Design and execute the legal and compliance strategy, maintaining controls, regulatory registers incidents and remediation tracking.
• Lead AML & KYC across client and investor onboarding, including sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, and escalation of suspicious activity.
• Ensure end-to-end regulatory compliance with Swiss FINMA requirements and coordinate governance funds including fund structuring.
• Act as a trusted legal and commercial advisor, drafting and negotiating, distribution and trading agreements, documentation and commercial contracts.
• Drive legal strategy and execution for fundraising initiatives, leading investor negotiations and facilitating the successful conversion of prospective investors.
• Oversee cross-border distribution and marketing controls, including EU distribution rules, target market/suitability assessments, and marketing material reviews.
• Serve as the main point of contact for regulators, auditors, and external counsel, managing regulatory interactions and audits with confidence.

The Successful Applicant
• University degree in Law, further education is an advantage
• 10-15 years of experience in legal and compliance roles within an asset management or preferably in a private equity firm
• Hands-on experience working with Luxembourg fund structures, combined with solid, practical exposure to Swiss FINMA regulation.
• Solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to draft and negotiate complex agreements while applying sound, pragmatic risk judgment.
• Demonstrated leadership capability, including managing small teams
• A strong team player with interpersonal skills and to engage with internal stakeholders, regulators and external parties.
• Fluency in German and English are a must have.

What's on Offer
• Coverage of a diverse stet of legal work with direct influence on the firm's regulatory and legal framework.
• High visibility role working closely with executive management and cross-border stakeholders.
• Attractive compensation package and long‑term career development

jobs.title: Directeur/ice Administratif/ve & Financier/e
jobs.description:
About Our Client
Notre client est un groupe suisse romand multi-activités reconnu pour la qualité de ses services, sa proximité avec ses clients et sa capacité à évoluer dans un environnement en constante transformation.Présent au travers de plusieurs entités complémentaires, le groupe poursuit une stratégie de développement fondée sur l'innovation, la performance opérationnelle et la création de valeur durable. Son modèle repose sur une forte culture entrepreneuriale, une gestion de proximité et une volonté permanente de satisfaire ses clients. Dans le cadre du renforcement de son équipe de direction, notre client recherche son futur ou sa future Directeur/trice Administratif/ve et Financier/ère . Le poste est basé dans le Canton de Vaud.

Job Description
Pilotage stratégique et accompagnement de la Direction Générale
* Accompagner la Direction Générale dans le développement des différentes unités et contribuer activement à la définition et à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie du groupe.
* Agir en véritable partenaire de la Direction Générale en apportant une vision financière, économique et opérationnelle aux décisions stratégiques, évaluer la rentabilité des activités, identifier les leviers de création de valeur et formuler des recommandations visant à améliorer durablement la performance, notamment dans le cadre de projets de développement, d'investissement et de transformation. Pilotage de la performance et discipline de gestion
* Élaborer les budgets annuels, les prévisions financières et les plans financiers à moyen terme.
* Développer et suivre les indicateurs de performance permettant un pilotage rigoureux de l'activité.
* Accompagner et challenger les directeurs dans l'analyse de leurs résultats, le suivi de leurs objectifs et la mise en œuvre de plans d'actions correctifs.
* Promouvoir une culture de responsabilité, de discipline budgétaire et d'amélioration continue à tous les niveaux de l'organisation.Gestion financière et administrative
* Superviser l'ensemble des fonctions financières, comptables et administratives du groupe.
* Garantir la fiabilité des informations financières ainsi que la qualité du reporting destiné à la Direction Générale et aux instances de gouvernance.
* Assurer une gestion proactive des liquidités, de la trésorerie et des flux financiers.
* Veiller à la bonne allocation des ressources financières et à la maîtrise des risques économiques.Gouvernance, conformité et gestion des risques
* Garantir le respect des obligations fiscales, légales et réglementaires applicables aux différentes entités du groupe.
* Assurer la préparation et la qualité de la documentation financière destinée au Conseil d'Administration.
* Superviser les aspects juridiques du groupe.
* Veiller au renforcement des processus de contrôle interne.Transformation et excellence opérationnelle
* Contribuer à l'optimisation et à l'automatisation des processus administratifs, financiers et des outils de gestion.
* Développer des tableaux de bord et des outils d'aide à la décision permettant de renforcer le pilotage de la performance.
* Participer aux projets de transformation visant à améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle, la qualité des processus et la fiabilité des données de gestion.
* Instaurer et faire vivre une culture d'exécution, de rigueur et de suivi des engagements au sein de l'organisation.

The Successful Applicant
Formation et expérience
* Formation universitaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou discipline équivalente.
* Expérience confirmée de 15 à 20 ans minimum dans des fonctions de direction financière et administrative au sein d'environnements multi-sociétés en Suisse.
* Solide expérience du management d'équipes et de l'accompagnement de dirigeants opérationnels.
* Excellente maîtrise des principes comptables, fiscaux, financiers et réglementaires applicables en Suisse.
* Expérience avérée dans le pilotage de projets stratégiques, de transformation organisationnelle ou d'amélioration de la performance.

jobs.title: UHNW Private Banker - Middle East (Geneva)
jobs.description:
About Our Client
Our client is a leading international private bank with a strong global presence and an established footprint across the Middle East. Renowned for its comprehensive wealth management offering, the bank provides tailored investment, lending and wealth structuring solutions.

Job Description
• Build, manage, and grow a portfolio of UHNW clients and family groups across the Middle East.
• Develop new client relationships through personal networks, referrals, strategic partnerships, and professional intermediaries.
• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing holistic wealth management solutions tailored to their complex needs.
• Deliver bespoke advice across investments, lending, wealth structuring, succession planning, and broader private banking services.
• Identify and execute opportunities to increase assets under management, revenues, and wallet share.
• Maintain regular client engagement through meetings, events, and market visits across the target markets.
• Collaborate closely with investment specialists, credit teams, wealth planners, and product partners to deliver integrated solutions.
• Keep clients informed on market developments, economic trends, and investment opportunities relevant to their portfolios.
• Ensure exceptional service standards and long-term relationship management.
• Manage all client activities in accordance with regulatory, compliance, and risk management requirements.

The Successful Applicant
Essential Requirements
• Minimum 10 years of experience within Private Banking or Wealth Management.
• Proven experience managing and acquiring UHNW and Ultra-UHNW clients.
• Demonstrable success in developing new business and generating significant net new assets.
• Established network of prospective clients and professional introducers across Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, and/or Qatar.
• Strong understanding of investment products, discretionary and advisory mandates, credit solutions, and wealth structuring concepts.
• Excellent relationship management and client servicing capabilities.
• Strong commercial mindset with the ability to identify and convert business opportunities.
• Experience operating within a regulated and risk-conscious environment.
• Fluent English; Arabic would be considered a strong advantage.
Preferred Experience
• Existing book of clients and a proven client acquisition track record within the Middle East market.
• Experience working with entrepreneurs, family offices, family groups, and principal investors.
• Strong knowledge of Gulf wealth dynamics and cross-border wealth management considerations.
• Ability to leverage an established regional platform and existing Middle East presence to accelerate business growth.
The successful individual will be:
• Entrepreneurial and highly self-motivated.
• Credible in front of sophisticated UHNW and family office clients.
• Well-connected within the Gulf region.
• Skilled at influencing and building relationships both internally and externally.
• Commercially driven while maintaining the highest standards of ethics, compliance, and risk management.
• Comfortable operating within a fast-paced, international environment.

What's on Offer
• Opportunity to join a leading international private banking platform with a strong and established presence in the Middle East.
• Access to a comprehensive suite of investment, lending, and wealth planning capabilities.
• Collaborative, high-performance environment focused on long-term client relationships.
• Significant growth opportunity within a strategically important market segment.

jobs.title: Directeur-trice des ventes
jobs.description:
About Our Client
Acteur historique de l'immobilier suisse depuis plus de 125 ans, deRham ouvre un nouveau chapitre de son développement et souhaite renforcer son organisation afin d'accompagner ses ambitions de croissance et de transformation.
Dans ce contexte, deRham recrute un-e Directeur-trice des Ventes, chargé-e de piloter l'ensemble des activités transactionnelles du groupe (résidentiel, ventes sur plan, haut de gamme et immobilier de rendement), tout en portant une réflexion prospective sur l'évolution du marché immobilier suisse, tant sur ses segments traditionnels que premium.
Au-delà de la performance commerciale, l'enjeu est de contribuer au repositionnement durable de l'activité transactionnelle en anticipant les évolutions du marché (digitalisation, nouveaux usages, attentes clients, durabilité) et en développant une offre différenciante.

Job Description
Rattaché-e au CEO, vous prenez la responsabilité de la Direction des Ventes et pilotez l'ensemble des activités transactionnelles du groupe. Vous définissez et mettez en œuvre la stratégie commerciale, développez les équipes et accompagnez l'évolution de l'activité dans un marché en constante mutation.
À ce titre, vous avez pour principales missions de :
• Développer les activités sur les segments stratégiques (résidentiel haut de gamme, immobilier de rendement, ventes sur plan) et renforcer la performance commerciale.
• Structurer une organisation performante, orientée client et résultats.
• Accompagner l'évolution de l'offre et des pratiques en intégrant les transformations du marché.
Leadership et management
• Diriger, fédérer et développer les équipes de vente.
• Piloter le P&L de l'activité.
• Instaurer une culture de performance, de collaboration et d'exigence.
• Accompagner le développement des collaborateurs et les recrutements.
Stratégie commerciale
• Définir et déployer la stratégie de développement de l'activité.
• Analyser les évolutions du marché immobilier suisse et adapter les orientations commerciales.
• Prioriser les segments de croissance et développer les partenariats.
• Suivre les indicateurs de performance (chiffre d'affaires, marges, portefeuille).
Développement des affaires
• Obtenir et piloter des mandats stratégiques.
• Développer et entretenir des relations avec une clientèle institutionnelle et privée (investisseurs, promoteurs, family offices, clients privés).
• Mobiliser votre réseau pour identifier de nouvelles opportunités.
Organisation et évolution de l'activité
• Optimiser les processus, les outils de pilotage et les pratiques commerciales.
• Favoriser l'utilisation des solutions digitales, de la data et du CRM afin d'améliorer la performance et l'expérience client.
• Contribuer à l'évolution de l'offre en lien avec les mutations du secteur.
Coordination
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les autres directions du groupe.
• Coordonner les partenaires externes intervenant sur les opérations de promotion.
• Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la Direction générale.

The Successful Applicant
Expérience et compétences
• Expérience confirmée dans la vente et le courtage immobilier en Suisse (idéalement 10 à 15 ans).
• Solide expérience en développement commercial, négociation de transactions et management d'équipes avec responsabilité P&L.
• Excellente connaissance d'au moins un des segments suivants : résidentiel haut de gamme, immobilier de rendement ou ventes sur plan.
• Réseau professionnel établi auprès des principaux acteurs du marché.
Vision stratégique
• Bonne compréhension des évolutions du marché immobilier suisse et de leurs impacts sur les activités de transaction.
• Capacité à intégrer les enjeux liés à la digitalisation, aux nouveaux usages, à la durabilité et aux attentes des clients dans la stratégie commerciale.
• Capacité à conjuguer vision stratégique et exécution opérationnelle.
Leadership
• Leadership fédérateur et orienté résultats.
• Style de management collaboratif, favorisant l'autonomie et le développement des équipes.
• Esprit entrepreneurial, sens de l'initiative et excellentes qualités relationnelles.
Critères spécifiques
• Réputation irréprochable (références, extrait du casier judiciaire et de l'Office des poursuites requis pour l'inscription au Registre du Commerce).
• Aisance dans un environnement entrepreneurial et une structure à taille humaine.

What's on Offer
Une opportunité unique de façonner un rôle qui allie direction commerciale et construction d'une vision stratégique du secteur, courant comme premium, ceci dans de bonnes conditions.

About Our Client
Prestigious hotel in the Swiss Alps

Job Description
• Oversee all Rooms Division operations, including Front Office, Housekeeping, Laundry, Reservations, and Concierge, managing large teams across departments
• Drive flawless execution of service in line with ultra-luxury hospitality standards (Forbes and 5-star excellence standards)
• Lead, develop, and empower department heads and teams, ensuring high performance, discipline, and engagement (100+)
• Deliver exceptional, personalized guest experiences while maintaining operational efficiency at scale
• Collaborate closely with Revenue, Sales, and F&B to optimize performance and guest satisfaction
• Act as a senior leader on the Executive Committee and representative of the hotel's standards and culture

The Successful Applicant
• Proven experience in a senior Rooms Division leadership role within a luxury or palace hotel (essential)
• Demonstrated ability to manage large teams in complex, high-volume luxury environments
• Strong leadership presence: decisive, structured, and naturally authoritative , with the ability to inspire respect
• Deep understanding of international luxury service standards and guest expectations
• Fluency in English required; German and/or French strongly preferred

What's on Offer
• A strategic leadership role within a prestigious palace hotel
• Exposure to a diverse, multi-departmental team in the Swiss Alps
• A dynamic and high-performance environment

jobs.description:
About Our Client
Renowned luxury resort located in one of Switzerland's most sought-after Alpine destinations.

Job Description
Strategic Leadership
• Define and execute the F&B vision in alignment with the hotel's positioning and brand standards
• Drive innovation across all dining concepts, ensuring relevance and differentiation in a highly competitive luxury market
• Collaborate with Executive Chef and senior leadership to create award-winning culinary and beverage programs
Operations Management
• Oversee all F&B outlets including fine dining restaurants, casual dining venues, bars, lounges, in-room dining, and banqueting
• Ensure flawless execution of service standards reflective of palace-level expectations
• Optimize operational efficiency, cost control, and revenue growth across all outlets
Financial Performance
• Manage budgets, forecasting, and P&L for the entire F&B division
• Drive profitability through strategic pricing, cost management, and revenue optimization initiatives
• Monitor KPIs and implement corrective actions where needed
People Leadership
• Lead, inspire, and develop a large, multicultural F&B team
• Foster a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement
• Identify and nurture future talent within the organization
Guest Experience
• Ensure an exceptional, personalized guest journey aligned with ultra-luxury service standards
• Maintain strong visibility in operations, interacting with high-profile international clientele
• Address guest feedback proactively and implement improvements
Compliance & Standards
• Ensure compliance with health, safety, and hygiene regulations
• Maintain the highest standards of quality, presentation, and service delivery

The Successful Applicant
•
• Extensive experience as F&B Director or Assistant F&B Director in luxury hotels or palaces A MUST
• Proven expertise managing large-scale, multi-outlet operations (high-volume + high-end positioning)
• Strong financial acumen with experience managing significant budgets and P&L responsibility
• Demonstrated ability to lead large teams in demanding, high-end environments
• Deep understanding of international luxury clientele and service expectations
• Strong operational presence combined with strategic vision
Language Requirements
• Fluent English and French are mandatory, Italian or German a plus
• Additional languages (e.g., German, Italian) are a plus
Personal Attributes
• Charismatic and inspiring leader with excellent communication skills
• Detail-oriented with a passion for excellence and innovation
• Hands-on, adaptable, and resilient in a fast-paced environment
• Strong sense of luxury service culture and guest-centric mindset

What's on Offer
• Opportunity to join a prestigious and internationally recognized luxury property
• Dynamic and high-performing environment in a prime Alpine destination
• Competitive compensation package and growth opportunities

jobs.title: Compliance Director
jobs.description:
About Our Client
Our client is a leading international financial services platform operating across multiple jurisdictions and serving a broad network of institutional clients, including banks, asset managers, insurance companies and pension funds.
As a regulated financial institution in Switzerland, the business operates within a highly governed environment and combines the stability of an established market participant with the agility and entrepreneurial mindset of a growing international organisation.
To support its continued development, our client is seeking an experienced Compliance Director to join its Swiss operation.

Job Description
Reporting to the Global Head of Compliance and working closely with the local executive leadership team, the Compliance Director will be responsible for overseeing the compliance framework of the Swiss regulated entity while supporting wider regional compliance initiatives.
This is a stand-alone senior compliance role offering significant autonomy, visibility and exposure to both local and international stakeholders.Key responsibilities include:
• Maintaining and enhancing the firm's compliance framework and control environment.
• Monitoring regulatory developments and ensuring timely implementation of applicable requirements.
• Acting as a primary point of contact with Swiss regulatory authorities and external auditors.
• Providing advice and guidance on regulatory, conduct and compliance matters to senior management and business stakeholders.
• Overseeing AML, KYC and broader financial crime compliance activities.
• Managing compliance monitoring, risk assessments and regulatory reporting processes.
• Supporting audits, regulatory reviews and remediation initiatives.
• Leading and contributing to strategic, regulatory and business transformation projects.
• Collaborating closely with Legal, Risk, Operations, HR and business functions to promote a strong culture of compliance.

The Successful Applicant
• Minimum 10 years of compliance experience within a regulated financial services environment.
• Strong knowledge of Swiss financial market regulation and practical experience interacting with regulatory authorities.
• Experience gained within asset management, wealth management, banking, securities, fintech, wealthtech or other regulated financial institutions.
• Solid expertise across compliance monitoring, governance, AML and KYC frameworks.
• Demonstrated ability to work independently and take ownership of a broad compliance remit.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior decision-makers.
• Pragmatic and commercially minded approach while maintaining high regulatory standards.
• Fluent English is required; additional European languages would be advantageous.
The successful candidate will be a hands-on compliance professional who enjoys operating in a lean environment and is equally comfortable managing strategic regulatory matters and day-to-day compliance responsibilities.

What's on Offer
• A visible and influential compliance leadership role within a successful international financial services organisation.
• Direct exposure to senior executives, global leadership teams and regulatory stakeholders.
• Broad responsibility covering Swiss regulatory matters and regional compliance initiatives.
• A collaborative, entrepreneurial and internationally focused working environment.
• Significant autonomy and ownership within a growing business.
• Competitive compensation package, including an attractive performance-related bonus.
• The opportunity to play a key role in the continued development of a dynamic and well-established organisation.

jobs.title: Marketing Director
jobs.description:
About Our Client
Our client is an international consumer-focused organization with a strong heritage, established brands, and operations across multiple global markets.
As part of an ambitious transformation and growth journey, the company is investing in its commercial and digital capabilities to strengthen customer engagement, accelerate growth, and enhance its market position. The business offers a dynamic international environment where innovation, entrepreneurial thinking, and commercial impact are highly valued.

Job Description
We are seeking a commercially minded Marketing Director to lead growth-driving marketing initiatives across international markets.
This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and requires an individual who is equally comfortable analysing business performance, shaping marketing investment decisions, and identifying new opportunities for profitable growth.The successful candidate will oversee customer acquisition activities, optimize marketing effectiveness, and help ensure that marketing investments generate sustainable business results. Working cross-functionally with commercial, digital, analytics, and regional teams, the role will play a key part in driving future growth across multiple geographies.
• Develop and execute international growth and customer acquisition strategies.
• Manage and optimize significant performance marketing investments across multiple channels and markets.
• Identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition, engagement, and commercial performance.
• Evaluate marketing effectiveness and recommend investment priorities based on business impact.
• Monitor market developments, customer trends, and emerging technologies.
• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to drive execution and business results.
• Build performance measurement frameworks and promote data-driven decision-making.
• Contribute to the development of marketing capabilities, processes, and best practices across the organization.

The Successful Applicant
• 10 years of experience in Marketing, Growth, Digital, Customer Acquisition, Commercial Excellence, or related disciplines.
• Proven track record in performance marketing managing investments and delivering measurable business impact.
• Experience within consumer-oriented industries such as consumer goods, retail, lifestyle, digital commerce, hospitality, subscription businesses, or similar sectors.
• Experience with channel Excellence with paid search engines (Google Ads, Shopping, Performance Max) Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Paid Social (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest and other relevant platforms) including display advertising video and YouTube)
• Strong commercial acumen and the ability to balance growth ambitions with profitability objectives.
• Analytical mindset with a data-driven approach to decision making
• Exposure to international markets and cross-border initiatives.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and execution-focused mindset.
• Fluent English.

What's on Offer
• A newly created position with significant visibility and influence.
• The opportunity to contribute to an international transformation and growth journey.
• Ownership of meaningful budgets and strategic initiatives.
• Exposure to senior decision makers and international stakeholders.
• A collaborative and entrepreneurial work environment.
• Long-term development opportunities within a growing and evolving organization.
• One day of home office per week

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
About Our Client
Our client is a well-established international consumer products company with a portfolio of premium brands and a strong market presence. As part of a larger corporate group undergoing continuous transformation and growth, the organization is focused on driving operational excellence, enhancing performance, and strengthening cross-functional collaboration.
To support its next phase of development, our client is seeking an experienced and business-oriented Chief Financial Officer to act as a strategic partner to the General Manager and contribute to long-term value creation.

Job Description
• Lead the Finance, Controlling, Accounting, and Administrative functions of the organization.
• Oversee financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting processes.
• Manage investment planning and capital expenditure monitoring.
• Ensure the timely preparation, review, and consolidation of financial statements.
• Monitor and analyze financial performance, including costs, margins, profitability, and operational efficiency indicators.
• Provide financial insights and recommendations to support strategic and operational decision-making.
• Partner with senior leadership to identify opportunities for value creation and business improvement.
• Lead, develop, and mentor the Finance and Administration team.
• Ensure effective treasury, cash flow, risk management, and compliance processes.
• Drive finance transformation initiatives, process improvements, and digitalization projects.
• Contribute to cross-functional and group-wide strategic projects.
• Serve as a key member of the leadership team and provide support to executive management when required.

The Successful Applicant
• University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field, complemented by relevant professional qualifications.
• Approximately 15 years of progressive experience in finance leadership positions, including significant exposure to operational and commercial business environments.
• Trilingue candidates required: fluency in English, in German and in Italian. Only trilingual candidates can be considered
• Proven track record as a hands-on finance executive with strong expertise in financial performance management, cost optimization, cash flow management, and profitability improvement.
• Strong business partnering capabilities, with experience influencing strategic decisions and supporting organizational growth.
• Experience within manufacturing, industrial, consumer products, or similarly operational environments is highly desirable.
• Deep understanding of operational drivers, cost structures, margin analysis, and performance improvement initiatives.
• Strong knowledge of modern ERP systems and advanced financial analysis tools
• Demonstrated leadership capabilities, excellent analytical skills, and a pragmatic, results-oriented approach.
• Strong communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills.

What's on Offer
• Opportunity to join a successful and growing organization with ambitious development objectives.
• Strategic leadership role with significant influence on business performance and future direction.
• Exposure to a dynamic and international environment with close interaction with senior decision-makers.
• Ability to drive meaningful transformation, optimization, and value creation initiatives.
• Attractive employment package aligned with the responsibilities of the position.
• Collaborative corporate culture that values leadership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

jobs.description:
About Our Client
Our client is a fast growing implantable medical devices company (Class III).

Job Description
1. Product Development & Industrialization
• Lead execution of the product development pipeline from concept to market launch
• Ensure successful industrialization of new products
• Drive manufacturing readiness, regulatory compliance, and launch preparedness
• Coordinate internal teams and external development partners
• Translate innovation into scalable, commercially viable products
• Balance quality, compliance, execution reliability, and time-to-market
2. Operations & Supply Chain Leadership
• Own the end-to-end operational value chain
• Lead Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Logistics, RA/QA, and Operational Excellence functions
• Ensure operational readiness to support commercial growth
• Strengthen supplier management and governance
• Maintain product quality and regulatory excellence
• Improve operational performance, resilience, and scalability
3. Operating Model & Capability Building
• Design and implement the company's future operating model
• Develop organizational capabilities, systems, processes, and governance
• Strengthen internal industrial and operational expertise
• Improve operational visibility and data-driven decision-making
• Build scalable planning, quality, and performance management capabilities
• Preserve agility while scaling the organization
4. Strategic Transformation & Organizational Scaling
• Partner with the CEO to support the company's next growth phase.
• Structure, Prioritize, and Execute the company Strategy in line with CEO's vision and pace of action.
• Lead the multi-year operational transformation roadmap
• Support the transition from a Co-CEO to a single-CEO structure
• Institutionalize operational knowledge and best practices
• Build a scalable operational leadership platform
• Enable international expansion while maintaining innovation, quality, and financial discipline

The Successful Applicant
The ideal candidate will bring:
• Experience operating in regulated medical device environments (mandatory), implantable strongly preferred
• Proven experience scaling operations in a high-growth environment
• COO, VP Operations, or equivalent leadership experience
• Strong exposure to: Product Development, Industrialization, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs & Quality
• Significant exposure to the US market is strongly preferred
• Strong business and commercial understanding
• Product intuition and appreciation for innovation
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
• High agency and strong ownership mentality
• Exceptional accountability and energy
• Pragmatic, hands-on approach
• Strong execution orientation
• Ability to remain calm under pressure
• Humility and confidence
• Direct and honest communication style
• Non-political, non-territorial mindset
• Data-driven decision making
• Ability to build teams, systems, and capabilities

What's on Offer
An unique opportunity to scale up operations in a fast growing company

jobs.description:
About Our Client
Our client, a well-established Swiss private bank with a long-standing heritage in wealth management, is seeking an experienced Senior Private Banker to join its growing teams in multiple locations .
This is an opportunity for entrepreneurial banking professionals with an established network and portable client relationships to join a highly reputable Swiss institution that offers autonomy, flexibility, and direct access to decision-makers.

Job Description
• Acquire, develop and manage a portfolio of High Net Worth (HNW) and Ultra High Net Worth (UHNW) clients.
• Build long-term client relationships through tailored wealth management solutions.
• Identify new business opportunities and drive assets under management growth.
• Deliver comprehensive investment, wealth planning and advisory solutions.
• Ensure full compliance with Swiss and cross-border regulatory requirements.
• Collaborate closely with investment specialists and senior management to deliver best-in-class client service.

The Successful Applicant
• Minimum 10 years of proven success as a Private Banker / Relationship Manager in Switzerland .
• Strong and stable track record of client acquisition and relationship management.
• Demonstrable network within Switzerland, Europe and/or the Middle East .
• Strong understanding of financial markets, investment products and wealth management solutions.
• Excellent knowledge of Swiss and cross-border regulations.
• CWMA-SAQ certification or equivalent qualification preferred.
• Entrepreneurial, self-driven and capable of working independently.
• Resident in Switzerland or eligible to work in Switzerland.
• We are particularly interested in professionals covering:
•
• Switzerland
• Western and Northern Europe
• Southern Europe
• Middle East (GCC markets especially welcomed)

What's on Offer
• The stability and reputation of an established Swiss private banking platform.
• A genuinely entrepreneurial environment with substantial autonomy.
• Direct access to senior leadership and swift decision-making processes.
• Competitive and direct performance-driven remuneration structure.
• Flexible and supportive platform for experienced bankers looking to grow their business.
• Long-term commitment to relationship-driven private banking.

This is an outstanding opportunity for an entrepreneurial luxury hospitality leader who combines commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and operational excellence with a passion for delivering world-class guest experiences.
The successful candidate will be a highly visible leader, equally comfortable engaging with guests, motivating teams, driving financial performance, and participating in strategic business decisions. • Lead the overall strategic and operational direction of the hotel.
• Develop and execute initiatives that strengthen market positioning, guest satisfaction, and financial performance.
• Drive a culture of excellence, accountability, innovation, and luxury service.
• Act as a trusted partner to ownership and the executive leadership team.
• Contribute to group-wide strategic projects, acquisitions, and growth initiatives.
Operational Excellence
• Ensure flawless delivery across all areas of the hotel operation.
• Maintain the highest standards of luxury hospitality and personalized guest service.
• Lead by example through a visible, hands-on management style.
• Continuously identify opportunities to improve quality, efficiency, and guest engagement.

• Assume full responsibility for the property's financial performance and P&L.
• Lead budgeting, forecasting, business planning, and performance management.
• Drive revenue growth and profitability through strong commercial leadership.
• Apply rigorous financial discipline while maintaining exceptional guest experiences.
• Identify opportunities for value creation and operational optimization.

• Recruit, develop, and retain top hospitality talent.
• Build and mentor a high-performing leadership team.
• Foster a culture of engagement, ownership, and professional development.
• Create a workplace environment that reflects the values of excellence and collaboration.

• Serve as ambassador for the hotel within the local market and internationally.
• Build strong relationships with guests, owners, business partners, and community stakeholders.
• Represent the hotel and the group at industry events and within relevant networks.

A sophisticated luxury hotel leader with Swiss roots, international perspective, strong financial acumen, entrepreneurial drive, and a genuine passion for hospitality -someone who leads from the front, thinks strategically, delivers results, and has the potential to grow into a larger regional or group leadership role as the organization expands.

• Proven success as a General Manager or senior executive within a luxury or ultra-luxury hospitality environment.
• Strong international exposure gained through leading properties, brands, or teams within internationally recognized hospitality organizations.
• Demonstrated experience driving business performance and operational excellence.
• Experience within a growing hospitality platform, multi-property environment, or international hotel group is highly desirable.

jobs.title: Head of Legal & Compliance Switzerland
jobs.description:
About Our Client
Our client is an international well-known asset manager based in Zurich.

Job Description
Regulatory & Compliance Leadership
• Serve as the designated Head of Compliance under Swiss financial market regulations and maintain accountability for the Swiss compliance framework.
• Act as the primary contact for FINMA, regulatory auditors, and internal audit on all supervisory matters, regulatory reviews, filings, and remediation activities.
• Oversee the implementation, maintenance, and continuous enhancement of the Compliance Management Framework, including risk assessments, policies, monitoring, training, and reporting.
• Act as Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) and lead the management of compliance incidents, investigations, and integrity-related matters.
• Monitor and assess regulatory developments and ensure timely implementation of relevant Swiss regulatory requirements.
Business Partnership & Stakeholder Management
• Act as a strategic partner to the business, balancing commercial objectives with regulatory and conduct risk considerations.
• Lead, develop, and inspire a high performing Legal & Compliance team of 4 headcounts
• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional development.
• Support strategic initiatives, new business developments, and organizational change from a legal and compliance perspective.
Legal Advisory & Governance
• Serve as the principal legal advisor to Swiss business activities, providing pragmatic and commercially focused legal guidance.
• Review, negotiate, and advise on a broad range of commercial, regulatory, corporate, and financial services agreements, including investment management, outsourcing, distribution, licensing, vendor, and intra-group arrangements.
• Ensure global legal documentation, policies, and frameworks are adapted and compliant with Swiss legal and regulatory requirements.
Advise senior management, governance committees, and the Board on legal, regulatory, governance, and risk-related matters.

The Successful Applicant
• Swiss law degree or equivalent
• 8-15 years of experience in legal and/or compliance roles within asset management industry in Switzerland
• Proven stakeholder management skills, advantage to have leadership experience
• Deep knowledge of Swiss financial market regulation, including FinSA, FinIA, CISA, AMLA, and FINMA regulatory requirements.
• Strong understanding of European financial services regulation, including MiFID, UCITS and related frameworks.
• Experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex commercial and financial services agreements.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior executives and Boards.
• Strong judgment, integrity, and ability to operate independently in a complex, international environment.
• Interest in technology enabled ways of working, including AI and process optimization initiatives
• Fluent in English and German.

What's on Offer
• A highly visible leadership role with direct exposure to FINMA, senior management, and the Board.
• The opportunity to shape the Swiss Legal & Compliance strategy within a leading international asset manager.
• A collaborative, global environment with strong influence on governance, risk management, and business decisions.

• Strong understanding of European financial services regulation, including MiFID, UCITS and related frameworks.
• Experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex commercial and financial services agreements.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior executives and Boards.
• Strong judgment, integrity, and ability to operate independently in a complex, international environment.
• Interest in technology enabled ways of working, including AI and process optimization initiatives
• Fluent in English and German.

What's on Offer
• A highly visible leadership role with direct exposure to FINMA, senior management, and the Board.

• A collaborative, global environment with strong influence on governance, risk management, and business decisions.
